What moves the estimate

Built on the linear-regression pipeline in NewYork_airbnb_price_predictor.py: pandas for cleaning, scikit-learn for the model. Every prediction on this page runs client-side in your browser against that model's actual trained coefficients — nothing is faked or looked up.
